title: The builder’s guide to GPT‑5.6
summary: Learn how startups use GPT-5.6 to build faster, more cost-efficient AI agents with smarter model selection and new Responses API capabilities.
body: Learn how startups use GPT-5.6 to build faster, more cost-efficient AI agents with smarter model selection and new Responses API capabilities.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了面向开发者和初创企业的GPT-5.6构建指南。文章详细介绍了开发人员如何利用GPT-5.6更智能的模型选择机制以及全新的Responses API，来构建速度更快、成本更高效的AI智能体应用。该指南为基于OpenAI最新模型栈进行复杂多步智能体编排提供了官方最佳实践与架构参考。
